title: On corank 4 unitary representations of classical groups
summary: In this paper, we explicitly classify the corank 4 unitary representations of symplectic or split odd special orthogonal groups over non-Archimedean local fields of characteristic zero, by classifying Arthur representations of corank 4 and verifying the corresponding unitary dual conjecture recently proposed by Hazeltine-Jiang-Liu-Lo-Zhang in [HJLLZ24].
